feed.headline: Israel and Greece Reach $3.5 Billion Defense Deal
feed.ai: Despite the growing diplomatic isolation of the government, the agreement makes clear that the Israeli defense industry is still finding considerable demand abroad.

feed.headline: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
feed.ai: Broadcaster RUV reports that 52.8% of voters rejected the government's proposal to resume accession talks.

feed.headline: Why is Ukraine's ex-defence minister calling for wartime elections?
feed.ai: Mykhailo Fedorov has called for elections, without addressing concerns over how they could be held while at war.

feed.headline: Putin Pledges Increased Strikes in Ukraine and Support for Iran
feed.ai: The Russian president promised continued retaliation against the Ukrainians and “full solidarity” with Iran.

feed.headline: At G20 Summit, Some U.S. Allies Push Back on Trump’s Economic Approach
feed.ai: At a summit meant to showcase President Trump’s economic policies as a model for the world, Europeans complained about tariffs and the war with Iran.

feed.headline: Keir Starmer, Former UK Prime Minister, Says He Will Resign From Parliament
feed.ai: Keir Starmer, who left Downing Street in July after pressure from his own party, said he would quit his parliamentary seat to focus on a role in international affairs and defense.

feed.headline: Édouard Balladur, Embattled French Prime Minister, Dies at 97
feed.ai: His time in office coincided with France’s fraught role in the 1994 Rwandan genocide and the corruption scandal known as the Karachi affair.

feed.headline: Ukrainian Drone Mastermind, Fired by Kyiv, Will Advise Italy’s Defense Chief
feed.ai: The appointment of Mykhailo Fedorov, a Ukrainian former defense minister, showed how other militaries are racing to adapt to battlefield changes accelerated by the war in Ukraine.

feed.headline: Sharp rise in utility bills pushes Russia's inflation further off target
feed.ai: The October increase follows a January rise and is the first double tariff hike in four years. The central bank warned it would push annual inflation further above its 4% target in an economy already squeezed by the costs of its war, sanctions and a 21% key interest rate.

feed.headline: Memory wars: Election clash over Germany's Nazi past as AfD eyes power in east
feed.ai: Remembering its role in the World Wars is a key aspect of modern Germany's identity but the AfD argues it is time to take a more positive view of the past.

feed.headline: Spanish Leader Says 5,000 Migrants Are Still in Ceuta, Weeks After Border Surge
feed.ai: Their continued presence has roiled the Spanish territory in Africa and heaped pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

feed.headline: Far Right Is Poised to Win in a German State, but Fight Over Power Won’t End There
feed.ai: State and federal leaders are trying to avoid sharing sensitive intelligence with the Alternative for Germany should it take power in a state’s elections next week.
